Additional comments:

questions.answer: BA

questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: The level of the courses were at an adequate level. exams were all written and alot MCQC, which were easy to pass. also you get alot of extra marks from completing assignments prior

questions.answer: Was similiar in many ways, but abit more confronting. And sadly there is culture for not showing up to the lectures as they a being recorded.

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer:
Preparation is key
Sufficient funds is key (you don't wan't to be stressing about money whilst away)
Expect to have a blast!
